ngaap.guidance: 2020 guidance updated 31-Jul-2020: Revenue $18.2 - $18.6 billion, up organically 3% - 5% on an adjusted pro forma basis (unchanged from previous guidance). GAAP net income margin of 7.1%+ (decreased from previous guidance of ~8.4%). Adjusted EBIT margin of 17.5%+ (increased from previous guidance of ~17.5%). GAAP EPS of $6.03 - $6.43 (decreased from previous guidance of $6.95 - $7.35). Non-GAAP EPS of $11.15 - $11.55 (unchanged from previous guidance). Operating cash flow and adjusted free cash flow at $2.8 - $2.9 billion and $2.6 - $2.7 billion, respectively (unchanged). ~$1.7 billion in share repurchases, inclusive of proceeds from divestitures announced year-to-date (unchanged). Guidance tables: revenue $18,200 to $18,600; net income $1,287+ to $1,345+; discontinued operations ~2; net interest expense ~255; income taxes 264 to 276; L3Harris Merger integration costs ~153; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~712; inventory step-up ~31; divestiture expenses and losses ~61; restructuring charges and other items ~26; impairment ~394; total adjustments 1,898 to 1,910; adjusted EBIT $3,185+ to $3,255+ (17.5%+). EPS bridge: GAAP $6.03 to $6.43; integration ~0.71; amortization ~3.29; step-up ~0.14; divestiture ~0.28; restructuring ~0.12; impairment ~1.82; NCI ~(0.16); total pre-tax ~6.20; taxes ~(1.08); after-tax ~5.12; non-GAAP $11.15 to $11.55. Cash flow: operating cash flow $2,784 to $2,884; net additions of PP&E ~(370); free cash flow $2,414 to $2,514; cash used for integration ~186; adjusted FCF $2,600 to $2,700.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (ALL acquired intangibles, incl. Exelis), fair-value inventory step-up, divestiture expenses/losses, restructuring and other items, impairment of goodwill and other assets / COVID-19 charges, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (i.e. it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration (and transaction) costs. FCF bridge values are the QUARTER column (two quarters: operating cash flow 1,335, capex (108), FCF 1,227, integration cash 91, adjusted FCF 1,318). Dollar tax effect / NCI portion not published. Prior-year bridge columns are pro forma (adjusted EBIT 745, EPS 2.51) and are not recorded.

notes: is.op_income is COMPUTED (revenue - cost of sales - ESA - other operating lines): neither the release nor the 10-Q prints an operating income line (the statement goes straight to income before income taxes); it equals the sum of segment operating income and the reconciling lines. Unlabeled totals in lines_raw carry bracketed labels; EPS lines are prefixed 'Basic:' / 'Diluted:'. bs.lines_raw = the release's condensed balance sheet (unclassified, no subtotals; '[Total ...]' labels are unlabeled totals) followed by the extra lines of the 10-Q classified balance sheet prefixed '10-Q: '. tca / tcl / deferred_tax_l / equity_parent / nci / shares_out are from the 10-Q; bs.tl is COMPUTED = total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities (the 10-Q prints no total-liabilities line). The release compares with 'pro forma' prior-year figures (Article 11 combined Harris + L3, 8-K of 4-May-2020) and 'adjusted pro forma'; those are NOT used in any main key or in py (py = prior-year GAAP column as printed). Cash flow is year to date (two quarters, 6 months). All schema self-checks pass.
